recent_posts.title: Two teams of developers compete to make a horror game about a YouTuber
recent_posts.summary: A YouTuber hires two teams of professional game developers (writers, 3D artists, and programmers) to create horror games based on themselves. Team Retro builds a PS1-style game while Team Realistic builds a Unity-based modern horror game. Both games follow the same story written by a freelance writer and feature custom 3D monster models. The creator plays through both games, comparing the retro and realistic approaches to horror game design.

recent_posts.title: Scratch superhero pothole jumping game levels
recent_posts.summary: A playful Scratch game concept where different superheroes (Superman, Batman, Spider-Man, Iron Man, Flash, Hulk) attempt to cross increasingly large potholes using their unique abilities. Each hero's powers are mapped to game mechanics, with some heroes succeeding easily and others (like the Hulk) failing due to their limitations.

recent_posts.title: I Made a Waterslide Horror Game on Scratch
I added your ideas to my horror game
recent_posts.summary: A game developer creates a horror game incorporating community suggestions from YouTube comments. Using AI tools like Tripo Studio and Love Art, they generate 3D models and animations for five increasingly absurd floor-based challenges, including a walking job application, a gamer character demanding feet pictures, a singing carpet version of Sabrina Carpenter, a giant thumbs-up button, and an oversized forehead. Each floor requires collecting specific items to defeat the monster, blending humor with basic game mechanics and AI-assisted asset creation.

recent_posts.title: Building a custom horror game in seven days for a streamer
recent_posts.summary: A developer documents their week-long process of creating a custom horror game for streamer Ludwig, incorporating his room, cat, and inside jokes. The project involved 3D modeling, animation, puzzle design, and collaboration with another modeler to recreate the streamer's room in detail. The game features parkour mechanics where the player collects items while avoiding a monster version of the streamer's cat.

recent_posts.title: Building a scratch prison game to hide credit card information
recent_posts.summary: A developer creates a multi-layered prison escape game in Scratch to hide their credit card information, challenging their sister to complete platforming, top-down shooter, trivia, and racing sections. The game includes various mechanics like spikes, trampolines, lasers, enemies, and boss fights, with real money rewards for completion. Despite initial struggles with controls and game mechanics, the sister gradually improves and successfully completes all challenges to win the credit card and shopping money.

recent_posts.title: Building a horror game in 5 hours with Rosebud AI
recent_posts.summary: A developer creates a horror game in 5 hours using Rosebud AI to prank his sister who claims cats aren't scary. The project involves generating 3D models, implementing jump scares with custom cat images and sound effects, creating a puzzle-based gameplay loop where players collect batteries to power a toy mouse that distracts the cat guarding the exit. The game runs directly in web browsers without installation, showcasing rapid prototyping capabilities of AI-powered game development tools.

recent_posts.title: Creating horror movies in Scratch programming language
recent_posts.summary: Two creators compete to make the best horror movie using Scratch, a visual programming language. One creates 'Miss Melody the Movie' about a music teacher trapped in a burning school, while the other makes 'Holly's Worst Day Ever' featuring personalized jump scares. The challenge involves creating animations, adding sound effects, and voice acting within a time limit, showcasing creative uses of Scratch beyond typical educational programming.

recent_posts.title: Building a surprise horror game for a friend
recent_posts.summary: A developer recounts the creation of a horror game designed for a friend's birthday surprise, highlighting the process, challenges, and humorous mishaps during development. The game, featuring a comically terrifying dog as the antagonist, requires players to solve puzzles to access the final scene, which displays the player's IP address—a critical aspect for the developer's plan. The story unfolds in a humorous and chaotic manner, showcasing creativity and the use of various tools, including, AI.

recent_posts.title: Developing a horror game in one day
recent_posts.summary: The post describes a creator's journey of developing a horror game in 24 hours. The game, set in an abandoned school haunted by ghostly teachers, aims to impress a critical player. The creator uses tools like Millanote for planning, Blender for 3D modeling, and Unreal Engine for building the game. The post emphasizes the importance of planning, creative design, and character development, highlighting challenges faced when crafting the game's storyline and aesthetic.
